nodes.name: curve-input
nodes.statement: the input is a valid coded curve and point predicate

nodes.name: height-bound-producer
nodes.statement: H is a primitive-recursive cutoff and every rational point has height at most H

nodes.name: code-cutoff
nodes.statement: every canonical point code of height at most H is below C(u,H)

nodes.name: bounded-filter
nodes.statement: filter all codes below C by the decidable point checker

nodes.name: complete-point-list
nodes.statement: the filtered list contains exactly all rational points
